attempts.note: Verified a complete conditional reduction to the existing open x2611_15210_thm1_4. Drafts: forge/data/staging/agents/queue-r7/queue-r7-w4/conditional.lean (no sorry; aux4 assumes exactly Theorem 1.4); conditional_check.lean compiles and #print axioms reports only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Aux1 proves binary zero sums of length n are constant; aux2 proves (n-1)*2^r+1 <= s(n,C_n^r); aux3 combines this with newly proved x2611_15210_thm1_1_s1h1 to show s(2k,C_2k^r) <= 3*s(k,C_k^r). Main idea: write k=2^a*m with m odd>=3, apply Theorem 1.4 to 2*k=2^(a+1)*m at p=1/2; divide its positive exponential constant by 3. This handles odd k as well, avoiding a separate odd-modulus construction. reduction.lean is the complete one-hole sketch, but ./forge.sh sketch rejected its high=Theorem1.4 hole because pretty printing Z^((1:Real)/4) loses the real exponent annotation, so the printed hole does not round-trip. Did not create redundant equivalent tasks. Remaining mathematics is exactly the existing Theorem 1.4, not proved in the current library. Small case r=1 agrees with EGZ threshold 2*k-1.
